newsitem.title: LATVIA: STRUZHANI PEAT, LIEPAJA OIL ON BOURSE ON JUNE 16.
newsitem.headline: STRUZHANI PEAT, LIEPAJA OIL ON BOURSE ON JUNE 16.

text.p: The Riga bourse said on Thursday that Struzhanu Peat and the Liepaja oil extraction firm will be quoted on the stock exchange's secoundary list from June 16.
"The bourse decided today to start quoting Struzhani and Liepaja on the secondary list from June 16," a bourse spokeswoman told Reuters.
"Riga Jewelry factory could also start trading on the secondary list, provided it submits its financial data today," she added.
The bourse also decided to renew the quotation of the secondary list stock Akta starting next Monday.
Akta's quotation was stopped earlier this month for failing submit mandatory financial reports in due time.
